bio.text: Amy Klobuchar is the first woman elected to represent Minnesota in the U.S. Senate and was sworn into her fourth term there.
Her campaign website states that she is running for Governor of Minnesota.
Before the Senate she headed the largest prosecutor's office in Minnesota for eight years.
She grew up in Minnesota, attended Wayzata High School, and graduated magna cum laude from Yale University and from the University of Chicago Law School.
